description: Applyra dependency updates: weekly, grouped, minimumReleaseAge 3 days, Actions pinned by digest. Majors wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Majors need an explicit decision, never an automatic PR.
npm minor/patch in one weekly PR.
GitHub Actions (SHA digests + version comments) in one PR.
CI tool images (gitleaks, osv-scanner, semgrep, actionlint) in one PR; tag + digest move together.
Node runtime follows LTS lines only: even majors, via approval like any major.

customManagers.description: Images referenced as `<image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>` in workflow `docker run` lines.
